role: The small decoration features of overworld population ported from oracle/src/world/gen/feature: sand and gravel disks, clay, flowers and mushrooms, tall grass, dead bush, reeds, cactus, pumpkins, lily pads, double plants, melons and vines, with the canBlockStay/canPlaceBlockAt rules each consults, and their FeatureProbePlants table rows.

structs.name: SAND, CLAY, FLOWERS, TALLGRASS, DEADBUSH, REED, CACTUS, PUMPKIN, WATERLILY, DOUBLE_PLANT, MELON, VINES
structs.java: the rows of oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/FeatureProbePlants.java's per-feature table, config order

gpu: lines 38-41 and 74-86: material and block-class identity by strcmp on names on every check (cost, not state)
lines 209-216 and 243-250, functions feature_tallgrass and feature_deadbush: for(;;) walk down the column bounded by y <= 0
lines 578-608, function features_plants_for: string-compare lookup table
notes: The feature_* functions are non-static but only reached through features_plants_for (no other file names them; decorator.c goes through the table). BlockPumpkin.onBlockAdded is not ported because its golem build is switched off (world.conf built_golems = off). The Nether mushroom variant of WorldGenFlowers lives in features_nether.c. BLK_* ids come from an included header.
